title: Practice 2: про-: through, past, and a distance covered

blocks.text: Exercises: sentences from Tatoeba (tatoeba.org, CC BY 2.0 FR) and from the library's public-domain books.

exercises.why: **про-** — Movement across, through, or past something — Мы проехали через город. — We drove through the city. — DLI, Lesson 62.  ·  Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).
exercises.prompt: I was just passing by.
exercises.context: про- — Movement across, through, or past something — Мы проехали через город. — We drove through the city.

exercises.why: **проплы́ть** — **проплыва́ть** — to swim by, to float by, to sail by; to swim (a certain distance or time), to sail (a certain distance or time). **пронести́** — **проноси́ть** — to carry (by, past, through), to smuggle, to sneak; (impersonal, colloquial). **провести́** — **проводи́ть** — to lead, to conduct, to guide, to steer, to take; to lay, to construct, to build, to install a road, a pipe, a wire etc.. **провезти́** — **провози́ть** — to transport, to convey. — DLI, Lesson 62.  ·  Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).
exercises.prompt: We pass under a bridge.
exercises.context: проплы́ть** — **проплыва́ть — to swim by, to float by, to sail by; to swim (a certain distance or time), to sail (a certain distance or time).

exercises.why: **про-** (temporal) — Prolonged multidirectional movement, with multidirectional verb of motion — Мы проходили по лесу весь день. — We walked around the woods all day. — without prep + acc.. — DLI, Lesson 62.  ·  Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.why: Проводить — провести — to lead through, to spend (time), to lay (a road). Note the expression: "проводить время" — to spend the time. *Как вы проводите время? Я хорошо провёл время. Мы провели в Европе два месяца. В прошлом году здесь провели несколько новых дорог.* **пройти́** — **проходи́ть** — to pass, to go, to walk; to pass by. **прое́хать** — **проезжа́ть** — to go through/by (by horse or vehicle), to ride through/by, to drive through/by; to drive past/along/across. — DLI, Lesson 79.  ·  Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).
